mcp_compatibility.adapter_guidance: Expose the HTTP endpoints below as MCP tools. Use the tool names, input schemas, auth rules and safety guardrails in this manifest.
mcp_compatibility.recommended_wrapper_transport: stdio or HTTP wrapper controlled by the customer machine

local_adapter.tested_flow: initialize, tools/list, read public sandbox test contract, create sandbox customer, buy target discovery, score lead opportunity, buy recommended add-on, create payment-test intent, reconcile payment test, list orders and usage
local_adapter.buyer_agent_flow: buyer machine reads catalog, sandbox test contract and onboarding, creates sandbox, buys target discovery when no list is available, scores one target, buys only the recommended add-on and verifies sandbox payment-test guardrails

authentication.customer_key_source: POST /v1/sandbox/customers for sandbox tests, or private beta onboarding for larger tests.

tools.name: get_product_catalog
tools.purpose: Read products, exact beta prices, deliverables, credit rules and allowed next purchases.
tools.output_summary: Machine-readable product catalog and price list.

tools.name: get_machine_onboarding
tools.purpose: Read the machine buyer flow, allowed calls, guardrails and public onboarding resources.
tools.output_summary: Public onboarding contract for automated evaluators.

tools.name: get_marketplace_api_directory_pack
tools.purpose: Read short marketplace, API directory, Postman, RapidAPI and MCP listing copy for machine-first discovery.
tools.output_summary: Machine-readable channel copy, product table, endpoint showcase and beta guardrails.

tools.name: get_marketplace_publication_execution_pack
tools.purpose: Read operational publication instructions for sandbox-only Postman, RapidAPI-style, generic API directory and MCP/tool registry listings.
tools.output_summary: Agent runbook for channel-specific publication preparation with guardrails.

tools.name: get_machine_api_sandbox_test
tools.purpose: Read the canonical direct sandbox test path for CRMs, AI agents and automated workflows when Postman UI or human contact is unavailable.
tools.output_summary: Machine-readable sandbox test contract with import assets, callable flow, safety limits and expected outcomes.

tools.name: get_dentists_beta_pack
tools.purpose: Read the current dentist vertical benchmark, product flow and commercial evidence before testing.
tools.output_summary: Dentist beta pack with 250-target benchmark and routing results.

tools.name: create_sandbox_customer
tools.purpose: Create a low-credit sandbox API key so a machine can test the beta flow without human sales contact.

evaluator_id.description: Optional stable identifier for the evaluator machine.

use_case.description: Optional plain-language description of the automated test.

tools.output_summary: Sandbox customer id, API key, expiry and small credit balances.

tools.name: get_customer_onboarding
tools.purpose: Read authenticated onboarding, balances, allowed products and next machine calls for one customer key.
tools.output_summary: Customer-specific onboarding, credits and safe next calls.

tools.name: score_lead_opportunity
tools.purpose: Score one business domain and decide whether the machine should discard, watchlist, nurture, buy deep analysis or request verification.

domain.description: Business domain without protocol, for example clinic3.it.

sector_hint.description: Optional sector hint such as dentist, real_estate, aesthetic_medicine.

country_hint.description: Optional country hint such as IT.

tools.output_summary: opportunity_score, confidence, decision, web_architect_review, commercial_strength, spend_policy, next_purchase and usage.
tools.credit_rule: Consumes one score credit only when the API produces a valid usable output.

tools.name: create_purchase_intent
tools.purpose: Create a beta order intent for a machine-readable paid output such as target discovery, deep analysis, nurture signal or action pack.

domain.description: Domain to analyze when buying domain-level outputs.

market.description: Market or niche for target discovery.

commercial_objective.description: What opportunity the machine wants to find, not a generic sector label.

source_score_request_id.description: Optional id of the score request that produced the purchase recommendation.

source_order_intent_id.description: Required for action_pack. Must reference an accepted Deep Analysis order for the same domain.

source_verification_order_intent_id.description: Optional for deep_analysis. When present, it must reference an accepted same-domain Verification order with a positive verdict.

verification_fixture.description: Sandbox-only for product_code=verification on .test domains. Produces verified_for_deep_analysis for positive gate validation.

reason.description: Machine-readable reason for the purchase intent.

tools.output_summary: Tracked beta order intent, delivery contract, immediate machine-readable output and remaining credits.
tools.credit_rule: Consumes the corresponding product credit only when the beta order intent is valid.

tools.name: list_orders
tools.purpose: Retrieve previous beta orders and machine-readable deliveries for the authenticated customer.
tools.output_summary: Recent beta order intents and deliveries.

tools.name: get_order
tools.purpose: Retrieve one beta order and its delivery by order_intent_id.
tools.output_summary: One beta order intent and delivery.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.purpose: Read current credit balances and usage for the authenticated customer machine.
tools.output_summary: Consumed credits, remaining credits and beta usage state.

tools.name: create_payment_test_intent
tools.purpose: Create a simulated test-mode checkout object for a product or beta order without executing a real payment.

product_code.description: Product being tested, for example score_pack_1k, target_discovery or deep_analysis.

provider_mode.description: Live, production and prod are blocked.

order_intent_id.description: Optional beta order id to associate with this simulated payment.

tools.output_summary: Payment-test id, simulated status, test webhook instructions, guardrails and usage state.
tools.credit_rule: Does not execute real payment and does not issue a fiscal invoice.

tools.name: get_payment_test_intent
tools.purpose: Read one simulated payment-test intent and its current reconciliation state.
tools.output_summary: One simulated payment-test object with no live payment.

tools.name: get_payment_test_reconciliation
tools.purpose: Reconcile one simulated payment test and verify that no live payment, duplicate credit activation or fiscal invoice occurred.
tools.output_summary: Reconciliation result, safety checks and blockers before real payments.

tools.name: get_admin_sandbox_metrics
tools.purpose: Admin-only monitor for 7-day sandbox test metrics, conversion signals and safety flags.
tools.output_summary: Sandbox keys, score usage, deep analysis orders, action pack orders, conversion rates and safety flags.

tools.name: get_machine_buyer_evidence_brief
tools.purpose: Read the latest full bounded beta evidence proving the machine-buyer flow, credit caps, Action Pack gate and safety results.

decision_values.discard: Do not spend more budget now.
decision_values.nurture: Save in nurturing and consider low-cost enrichment.
decision_values.buy_deep_analysis: Buy a deeper machine-readable explanation before larger spend.
decision_values.needs_verification: Verify data quality before spending more budget.

commercial_strength_rules.strong: Controlled spend is allowed; buy Deep Analysis and consider Action Pack only after deep confirmation.
commercial_strength_rules.medium: Buy only low or mid-cost next steps such as Nurture Signal or Deep Analysis.
commercial_strength_rules.weak: Keep in watchlist and do not buy paid add-ons now.

latest_mcp_write_capped_sandbox_probe.interpretation: A machine client can use the local stdio MCP adapter to create one sandbox customer and score one provided synthetic target under a strict 2-POST budget, without purchases, payment-test intents, external contact or publication.

latest_mcp_purchase_decision_probe.interpretation: A machine can move from product discovery to score-based sandbox purchase intent and delivery retrieval through MCP without human outreach, real payment or external contact.

latest_mcp_verification_gate_probe.interpretation: A machine can stop before Deep Analysis when verification returns keep_with_caution and does not provide an immediate positive purchase gate.

latest_mcp_deep_analysis_verification_ga.interpretation: A machine cannot buy Deep Analysis from a cautious Verification source; the live API returns deep_analysis_verification_gate_failed and consumes no Deep Analysis credit.
latest_mcp_deep_analysis_verification_ga.recommended_next_step: Publish this evidence in public manifests and monitor, then test the positive verification path when a positive verdict fixture exists.

latest_mcp_positive_verification_deep_an.interpretation: A machine can buy Deep Analysis after a positive sandbox Verification source; the live API records a passed gate and consumes exactly one Deep Analysis credit.
latest_mcp_positive_verification_deep_an.recommended_next_step: Keep both negative and positive gate probes in the monitor; next test should cover Action Pack only after accepted Deep Analysis.

latest_mcp_action_pack_deep_analysis_gat.interpretation: A machine cannot buy Action Pack without a valid Deep Analysis source; after accepted same-domain Deep Analysis, the live API records a passed gate and consumes exactly one Action Pack credit.
latest_mcp_action_pack_deep_analysis_gat.recommended_next_step: Keep this gate probe in the monitor; next test should cover ledger durability and replay/idempotency across the full machine purchase ladder.

latest_mcp_full_chain_idempotency_probe.interpretation: A buyer machine can retry Score, Deep Analysis and Action Pack with the same Idempotency-Key; the live API marks each retry as duplicate and consumes only one credit per actual unit.
latest_mcp_full_chain_idempotency_probe.recommended_next_step: Keep this idempotency probe in the public monitor; next test should cover no-write marketplace/distribution readiness for machine discovery channels.
